description: Complete searchable archive of HDB resale flat transactions (via data.gov.sg): every resale transaction from Jan 1990 to the current month, with derived analytics — median price and price-per-sqm by town and flat type, volume by month and year. Independent tool; not affiliated with HDB or GovTech.
name: hdb-resale-intelligence
title: HDB Resale Intelligence — Singapore HDB Resale Flat Prices Archive 1990–Present
